prayerExcerpt.en-US: When the Judge comes, may we be among those blessed to behold him reigning in heaven.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Concedei-nos a alegria de contemplar, reinando no céu, aquele cuja vinda, como juiz, foi por ele anunciada na terra.

meta.face: A man of about sixty, clean-shaven, with a long, full oval face and a smooth, broad forehead — a long, straight nose with a fleshy, rounded tip, large dark, heavy-lidded eyes under high, rounded arched brows, full, smooth cheeks, a small, firm mouth and a full, rounded chin; greying dark hair in a thick Dominican corona around the shaven crown; an intent, earnest gaze toward the viewer.
meta.basis: Joan de Joanes's sixteenth-century Valencian portrait fixed his type: a clean-shaven, full oval face with a long nose and heavy-lidded eyes, the tonsure, the raised finger and the book. The wings are his title as the Angel of the Apocalypse (Rev 14:6–7); the older, greying face keeps him apart from the young Dominic and Thomas.
